note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. Catholicism is the official religion, with freedom of other religions guaranteed by the constitution. Monaco has never levied income tax on individuals and is linked to France by a customs union. It has no conscript army: France provides for its wider defence, and the Prince's own force is the small Compagnie des Carabiniers du Prince. Immigration, energy, internet, healthcare and education entries are gameplay estimates.
